description: Defines the five Book 4 (OR) operators, their roles, bindings, and sequence within the opacity-revelation evaluation cycle.

operators.name: OpacityGradient
operators.role: Measures or assigns the opacity gradient value ω ∈ [0,1] for a target structure.
operators.notes: Primary entry operator for any OR evaluation. Must always run before OR-Ρ. ω(S) is a property of S's configuration, not of any observer. Sets the ω value used by all downstream operators.

operators.name: DetectionCapacity
operators.role: Declares the observer detection capacity δ ∈ [0,1] for the current observer O in the current context.

book3_binding.role: SD-Σd output is the primary substrate for δ estimation in OR context. OR-Δ applies context adjustment on top of the SD-Σd result.

operators.notes: Observer-dependent. δ may vary for the same observer across different contexts. Must be declared and recorded before OR-Ρ executes. δ is not a property of S.

operators.name: RevelationCheck
operators.role: Gate operator. Evaluates the revelation condition: δ(O) > ω(S). Returns revelation_state.
operators.input: δ(O) from OR-Δ, ω(S) from OR-Ω

gate_logic.revealed: δ(O) > ω(S) — proceed to reveal phase
gate_logic.threshold: δ(O) = ω(S) — assign opaque; record threshold event
gate_logic.opaque: δ(O) < ω(S) — proceed to probe phase

preconditions: OR-Ω has run and ω(S) is recorded
OR-Δ has run and δ(O) is recorded
operators.notes: Core gating operator. Violation: invoking OR-Ρ before OR-Ω or OR-Δ complete. Threshold case (δ=ω) must always resolve to opaque — conservatism principle.

operators.name: LatentProbe
operators.role: Probes the latent sub-structure set: identifies all s_i ∈ sub(S) for which ω(s_i) ≥ δ(O). Detects structural shadows.
operators.input: Structure S with sub-structure opacity assignments, δ(O)
operators.output: S_latent: { s_i : ω(s_i) ≥ δ }, S_access: { s_i : ω(s_i) < δ }, shadow_set
preconditions: OR-Ρ has run and revelation_state is recorded
operators.skip_condition: Skip when revelation_state = revealed and sub(S) = ∅ (atomic structure, fully revealed)
operators.notes: Highest drift cost in the operator set. Produces the latent set and shadow set that feed PartialIndex. Structural shadows are detectable via SD-Σd and SD-Γ with OR-context adjustment.

operators.name: PartialIndex
operators.role: Synthesis operator. Indexes the full partial revelation state: builds revelation_map { s_i → state_i } across all sub-structures of S.
operators.input: S_latent, S_access, shadow_set from OR-Λ; δ(O)
operators.output: revelation_map: { s_i → state_i } where state_i ∈ {revealed, opaque, shadow}
downstream_bindings: Book 5 (TEL): revelation_map feeds TEL encoding of OR-qualified structures
Book 6 (Governance): opacity profiles from revelation_map feed regime opacity analysis
Book 8 (NoS): opacity as a structural-ontological property analysed via this output
operators.notes: Final operator in the OR cycle. Output is the canonical opacity-revelation state of S relative to O. Must not be called until OR-Λ has produced S_latent and S_access.

sequence_summary: Assign structural opacity, declare observer capacity, gate on revelation threshold, probe latent sub-structures, index partial revelation state.
must_not: invoke OR-Ρ before OR-Ω has completed
invoke OR-Ρ before OR-Δ has completed
treat the threshold case (δ=ω) as revealed
assign ω as a property of any observer
fabricate δ without SD-Σd grounding from Book 3
suppress latent structure without OR-Λ result
declare full revelation without checking all s_i individually

qmroot_binding.INV-013: 0D only — all operators trace to 0D Silence Seed via Book 1 kernel
